dex.text: A pale horse that walks on the water of Lough Gur once in seven years, its shoes ringing like bells. Its rider is asleep. It is not.
dex.fact: Legend says Gearóid Iarla, the poet Earl of Desmond, sleeps under Lough Gur and rides out every seven years on a horse shod with silver; when the shoes wear out, he will return.
